messages:
sarah: Quick sync 1 Procurement received a POC quote from MetricMint for our billing reconciliation tool. They propose a 90-day PoC with a $4k/mo platform fee + per-token overage. Can finance/procurement/legal weigh in on negotiable items?

ben: Paste the numbers and any auto-renew language? Also need to know if retention and alerting are included.

sarah: Quote excerpt:
```
POC fee: $4,000/month (covers up to 10M tokens/day)
Overage: $0.000022/token
Retention (365d): $900/month optional
Alerts & Custom Metrics: $600 one-time setup
Auto-renew: rolls into 12-month term unless canceled 30 days prior
```
Estimated load: ~6M tokens/day avg, but notebooks + load tests could spike.

mike: 30d cancel on auto-renew is too short. We should push for opt-in to annual or at least 60d notice. Also request a hard spend cap for the POC to avoid surprise charges during tests.

anya: Legal notes: ask for explicit billing export format (CSV/JSON) with line items per API route, model, and timestamp. We need meter mapping to reconcile invoices. Also add data deletion clause: vendor deletes raw logs within 30 days after termination unless we request retention.

procurement-bot: Reminder 1 for pilots >$3k/mo we need vendor security questionnaire + MSA. Initiate onboarding if proceeding.

ben: From finance: ask for a POC credit or pro-rated trial credits tied to successful integration metrics (e.g., ingest of sample dataset + billing CSV delivered). If they can't provide credits, insist on a clear overage cap (e.g., $5k/mo) for the POC.

mike: Engineering ask: can we get a sandbox which can simulate spikes and produce sample invoice outputs? We need to validate tokenization (are they using model-native tokens or some internal char count?)

anya: Contract redlines to propose:
``
1) No automatic conversion to multi-year without explicit written agreement.
2) POC capped spend not to exceed $5,000/month.
3) Vendor must provide detailed billing export with meter mapping and sample CSV prior to PO.
4) Data deletion certification within 30 days of termination.
```

sarah: Action items: 1) Ben to request POC credit / capped spend; 2) Mike to ask MetricMint for sandbox + tokenization docs + sample invoices; 3) Anya to draft short redline for the POC; 4) Procurement-bot to collect security docs if we proceed. Holding PO until billing CSV and legal OK.

ben: Adding: if MetricMint can offer month-to-month pricing after POC (no auto-transition), that's a big plus. I'll push on that.

sarah: Thanks all 44D
